1	// This file implements lossless archiving of one organization's audit
2	// export. AuditExport hands back detached in-memory records and the caller
3	// separately retains the checkpoint pinning them; an archive serializes the
4	// export so it can be saved to a file when the service instance ends and
5	// read back later, still paired with the caller's own checkpoint and still
6	// usable as the material for RecheckDecisionOffline.
7	//
8	// The format is a length-delimited binary encoding built by hand rather
9	// than encoding/json: JSON text cannot carry bytes that are not valid
10	// UTF-8 without silently replacing them with U+FFFD, which would collapse
11	// genuinely different content (a lone 0xFF, a lone 0xFE and a real U+FFFD)
12	// onto identical records and change their fingerprints. Every string is
13	// written from its exact bytes with a length prefix, and nil slices,
14	// non-nil empty slices and absent payloads are each marked explicitly.
15	//
16	// Integrity never comes from trust in the file. A decode reconstructs the
17	// records and then runs the same whole-material VerifyAudit chain check
18	// against the checkpoint the caller supplies independently; the checkpoint
19	// embedded in the archive is informational only and never authoritative.
20	package darksafe
21	
22	import (
23		"bytes"
24		"crypto/sha256"
25		"encoding/binary"
26		"errors"
27		"fmt"
28	)
29	
30	// ErrInvalidArchive means archive bytes are not a recognizable, complete,
31	// untampered audit archive: a foreign/truncated/trailing-byte framing, a
32	// failed checksum, or content that does not decode. Content-level failures
33	// (missing or mismatched organization, missing, out-of-order or modified
34	// records, a mismatched checkpoint) keep using ErrMissingOrganization and
35	// ErrInvalidRange exactly as the other audit entry points do.
36	var ErrInvalidArchive = errors.New("darksafe: invalid audit archive")
37	
38	// Archive framing:
39	//
40	//	magic   = archiveMagic
41	//	u32 BE  = byte length of the payload that follows
42	//	payload = archivePayloadLen bytes
43	//	32 bytes = SHA-256 checksum of payload
44	//
45	// A second archive concatenated to a first is trailing material, not a
46	// second frame: a read consumes exactly one frame and rejects any byte
47	// beyond it.
48	const archiveMagic = "darksafe-audit-archive-v1\n"
49	
50	const (
51		archiveTagBoolFalse byte = 0
52		archiveTagBoolTrue  byte = 1
53		archiveTagNil       byte = 0
54		archiveTagPresent   byte = 1
55	)
56	
57	// archiveWriter appends length-delimited fields to a byte buffer.
58	type archiveWriter struct {
59		buf []byte
60		err error
61	}
62	
63	func (w *archiveWriter) raw(data []byte) {
64		w.buf = append(w.buf, data...)
65	}
66	
67	// u32 writes a non-negative int as a big-endian uint32.
68	func (w *archiveWriter) u32(v int) {
69		if v < 0 || uint64(v) > 0xffffffff {
70			w.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: length out of range: %d", ErrInvalidArchive, v)
71			return
72		}
73		var b [4]byte
74		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(b[:], uint32(v))
75		w.buf = append(w.buf, b[:]...)
76	}
77	
78	func (w *archiveWriter) boolean(v bool) {
79		if v {
80			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagBoolTrue)
81		} else {
82			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagBoolFalse)
83		}
84	}
85	
86	// stringField writes a string from its exact memory bytes. Nothing is
87	// validated, replaced or normalized: a lone 0xFF reaches the output as
88	// itself and stays distinguishable from 0xFE and a genuine U+FFFD.
89	func (w *archiveWriter) stringField(s string) {
90		w.u32(len(s))
91		if w.err != nil {
92			return
93		}
94		w.buf = append(w.buf, s...)
95	}
96	
97	// stringList preserves the slice shape explicitly: nil is one marker, a
98	// non-nil list is a marker, a count and the raw strings.
99	func (w *archiveWriter) stringList(items []string) {
100		if items == nil {
101			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagNil)
102			return
103		}
104		w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagPresent)
105		w.u32(len(items))
106		for _, s := range items {
107			w.stringField(s)
108		}
109	}
110	
111	// policy mirrors Policy. ResourceID is always written so every field round
112	// trips on its own; it participates in the fingerprint regardless, so its
113	// placement does not move any fingerprint boundary.
114	func (w *archiveWriter) policy(p Policy) {
115		w.stringField(p.ID)
116		w.stringField(p.Subject)
117		w.stringField(p.Action)
118		w.stringField(p.Scope)
119		w.stringField(string(p.Effect))
120		w.boolean(p.Recursive)
121		w.stringField(p.ResourceID)
122	}
123	
124	func (w *archiveWriter) policyList(policies []Policy) {
125		if policies == nil {
126			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagNil)
127			return
128		}
129		w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagPresent)
130		w.u32(len(policies))
131		for _, p := range policies {
132			w.policy(p)
133		}
134	}
135	
136	// change writes the policy-change payload, or a single absence marker:
137	// VerifyAudit only ever accepts a change payload on a policy-change record
138	// and its absence otherwise, but the distinction is encoded explicitly so
139	// decode never has to reconstruct a shape.
140	func (w *archiveWriter) change(c *PolicyChange) {
141		if c == nil {
142			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagNil)
143			return
144		}
145		w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagPresent)
146		w.u32(c.Version)
147		w.policyList(c.Policies)
148		w.u32(c.SourceVersion)
149		w.boolean(c.RolledBack)
150	}
151	
152	func (w *archiveWriter) subject(su Subject) {
153		w.stringField(su.ID)
154		w.stringField(su.Kind)
155		w.stringList(su.Roles)
156		w.boolean(su.Disabled)
157	}
158	
159	func (w *archiveWriter) resource(r Resource) {
160		w.stringField(r.ID)
161		w.stringField(r.Scope)
162	}
163	
164	func (w *archiveWriter) decision(d Decision) {
165		w.boolean(d.Allowed)
166		w.stringField(d.Reason)
167		w.stringList(d.Matched)
168		w.u32(d.Version)
169	}
170	
171	func (w *archiveWriter) decisionRecord(d *DecisionRecord) {
172		if d == nil {
173			w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagNil)
174			return
175		}
176		w.buf = append(w.buf, archiveTagPresent)
177		w.stringField(d.Request.SubjectOrg)
178		w.stringField(d.Request.ResourceOrg)
179		w.subject(d.Request.Subject)
180		w.resource(d.Request.Resource)
181		w.stringField(d.Request.Action)
182		w.decision(d.Decision)
183	}
184	
185	// EncodeAuditArchive serializes one complete audit export into savable
186	// bytes. org is the organization name, records is its complete chain from
187	// sequence 1 (a valid prefix ending at some historical sequence is enough,
188	// provided cp pins exactly that sequence), and cp is the checkpoint the
189	// caller separately retains. An organization with no records archives too:
190	// records is empty and cp is its sequence-0 genesis checkpoint.
191	//
192	// The whole material is validated exactly as VerifyAudit would before any
193	// bytes are returned: a missing organization is ErrMissingOrganization, and
194	// a missing, out-of-order or foreign record, modified content or checkpoint
195	// mismatch is ErrInvalidRange. On failure no archive bytes are returned.
196	// The checkpoint is carried in the archive for reference, but never stands
197	// in for the separately retained evidence: DecodeAuditArchive always
198	// validates against the checkpoint handed to it. The call is read-only:
199	// neither the records nor any service state are mutated and no audit record
200	// is appended.
201	func EncodeAuditArchive(org string, records []AuditRecord, cp Checkpoint) ([]byte, error) {
202		if org == "" {
203			return nil, ErrMissingOrganization
204		}
205		if err := VerifyAudit(org, records, cp); err != nil {
206			return nil, err
207		}
208	
209		pw := &archiveWriter{}
210		pw.stringField(org)
211		pw.u32(cp.EndSeq)
212		pw.stringField(cp.Fingerprint)
213		pw.u32(len(records))
214		for i := range records {
215			r := &records[i]
216			pw.stringField(r.Org)
217			pw.u32(r.Seq)
218			pw.stringField(r.Kind)
219			pw.change(r.Change)
220			pw.decisionRecord(r.Decision)
221			pw.stringField(r.PrevFingerprint)
222			pw.stringField(r.Fingerprint)
223		}
224		if pw.err != nil {
225			return nil, pw.err
226		}
227		payload := pw.buf
228	
229		out := make([]byte, 0, len(archiveMagic)+4+len(payload)+sha256.Size)
230		out = append(out, archiveMagic...)
231		var lenBuf [4]byte
232		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(lenBuf[:], uint32(len(payload)))
233		out = append(out, lenBuf[:]...)
234		out = append(out, payload...)
235		sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
236		out = append(out, sum[:]...)
237		return out, nil
238	}
239	
240	// archiveReader walks one payload without copying string contents: string
241	// fields are backed by the payload slice itself, which is owned by the
242	// decoder and never returned, so callers cannot mutate the input through
243	// the result.
244	type archiveReader struct {
245		data []byte
246		pos  int
247		err  error
248	}
249	
250	func (r *archiveReader) need(n int) bool {
251		if r.err != nil {
252			return false
253		}
254		if n < 0 || r.pos > len(r.data)-n {
255			r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: truncated archive payload", ErrInvalidArchive)
256			return false
257		}
258		return true
259	}
260	
261	func (r *archiveReader) marker() byte {
262		if !r.need(1) {
263			return 0
264		}
265		b := r.data[r.pos]
266		r.pos++
267		return b
268	}
269	
270	func (r *archiveReader) u32() int {
271		if !r.need(4) {
272			return 0
273		}
274		v := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(r.data[r.pos : r.pos+4]))
275		r.pos += 4
276		return v
277	}
278	
279	// boundedCount reads a count and proves at least minBytesPerItem bytes
280	// remain per item, so a hostile payload cannot drive a huge allocation
281	// with a count its body could never satisfy.
282	func (r *archiveReader) boundedCount(minBytesPerItem int) int {
283		n := r.u32()
284		if r.err != nil {
285			return 0
286		}
287		if n < 0 || uint64(n)*uint64(minBytesPerItem) > uint64(len(r.data)-r.pos) {
288			r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: implausible list count %d", ErrInvalidArchive, n)
289			return 0
290		}
291		return n
292	}
293	
294	func (r *archiveReader) boolean() bool {
295		switch r.marker() {
296		case archiveTagBoolTrue:
297			return true
298		case archiveTagBoolFalse:
299			return false
300		default:
301			if r.err == nil {
302				r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid boolean marker", ErrInvalidArchive)
303			}
304			return false
305		}
306	}
307	
308	func (r *archiveReader) stringField() string {
309		n := r.u32()
310		if r.err != nil {
311			return ""
312		}
313		if !r.need(n) {
314			return ""
315		}
316		// Conversion copies the bytes, so the result never aliases the input.
317		s := string(r.data[r.pos : r.pos+n])
318		r.pos += n
319		return s
320	}
321	
322	func (r *archiveReader) stringList() []string {
323		switch r.marker() {
324		case archiveTagNil:
325			return nil
326		case archiveTagPresent:
327		default:
328			if r.err == nil {
329				r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid list marker", ErrInvalidArchive)
330			}
331			return nil
332		}
333		n := r.boundedCount(4) // each item carries at least one length word
334		if r.err != nil {
335			return nil
336		}
337		items := make([]string, n)
338		for i := range items {
339			items[i] = r.stringField()
340		}
341		return items
342	}
343	
344	func (r *archiveReader) policy() Policy {
345		var p Policy
346		p.ID = r.stringField()
347		p.Subject = r.stringField()
348		p.Action = r.stringField()
349		p.Scope = r.stringField()
350		p.Effect = Effect(r.stringField())
351		p.Recursive = r.boolean()
352		p.ResourceID = r.stringField()
353		return p
354	}
355	
356	func (r *archiveReader) policyList() []Policy {
357		switch r.marker() {
358		case archiveTagNil:
359			return nil
360		case archiveTagPresent:
361		default:
362			if r.err == nil {
363				r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid policy list marker", ErrInvalidArchive)
364			}
365			return nil
366		}
367		// A policy writes six length words (five strings plus ResourceID) and
368		// one bool byte at minimum.
369		n := r.boundedCount(6*4 + 1)
370		if r.err != nil {
371			return nil
372		}
373		policies := make([]Policy, n)
374		for i := range policies {
375			policies[i] = r.policy()
376		}
377		return policies
378	}
379	
380	func (r *archiveReader) change() *PolicyChange {
381		switch r.marker() {
382		case archiveTagNil:
383			return nil
384		case archiveTagPresent:
385		default:
386			if r.err == nil {
387				r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid change payload marker", ErrInvalidArchive)
388			}
389			return nil
390		}
391		c := &PolicyChange{}
392		c.Version = r.u32()
393		c.Policies = r.policyList()
394		c.SourceVersion = r.u32()
395		c.RolledBack = r.boolean()
396		return c
397	}
398	
399	func (r *archiveReader) subject() Subject {
400		var su Subject
401		su.ID = r.stringField()
402		su.Kind = r.stringField()
403		su.Roles = r.stringList()
404		su.Disabled = r.boolean()
405		return su
406	}
407	
408	func (r *archiveReader) resource() Resource {
409		var res Resource
410		res.ID = r.stringField()
411		res.Scope = r.stringField()
412		return res
413	}
414	
415	func (r *archiveReader) decision() Decision {
416		var d Decision
417		d.Allowed = r.boolean()
418		d.Reason = r.stringField()
419		d.Matched = r.stringList()
420		d.Version = r.u32()
421		return d
422	}
423	
424	func (r *archiveReader) decisionRecord() *DecisionRecord {
425		switch r.marker() {
426		case archiveTagNil:
427			return nil
428		case archiveTagPresent:
429		default:
430			if r.err == nil {
431				r.err = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid decision payload marker", ErrInvalidArchive)
432			}
433			return nil
434		}
435		d := &DecisionRecord{}
436		d.Request.SubjectOrg = r.stringField()
437		d.Request.ResourceOrg = r.stringField()
438		d.Request.Subject = r.subject()
439		d.Request.Resource = r.resource()
440		d.Request.Action = r.stringField()
441		d.Decision = r.decision()
442		return d
443	}
444	
445	// DecodeAuditArchive reads one archive produced by EncodeAuditArchive and
446	// returns records that can be handed directly to RecheckDecisionOffline.
447	// org is the organization the caller expects, and cp is the checkpoint the
448	// caller independently retained; the checkpoint embedded in the file is
449	// never treated as evidence, so even an archive carrying a plausible
450	// checkpoint only validates against the one supplied here.
451	//
452	// A missing organization is ErrMissingOrganization. Unrecognized framing,
453	// truncation, a trailing second archive or any other extra byte, a bad
454	// checksum, and undecodable content are ErrInvalidArchive. Records that
455	// decode but are missing, out of order, foreign to the organization,
456	// modified (including a record after the one the caller intends to review)
457	// or mismatched with the supplied checkpoint fail the whole read with
458	// ErrInvalidRange. Failure returns no records. A successful read only
459	// proves the material matches the checkpoint: an original decision that
460	// disagrees with a recomputed one is reported later by offline review, not
461	// treated as archive damage. The result is detached from archive (mutating
462	// one never reaches the other), and the call is read-only.
463	func DecodeAuditArchive(archive []byte, org string, cp Checkpoint) ([]AuditRecord, error) {
464		if org == "" {
465			return nil, ErrMissingOrganization
466		}
467		magicLen := len(archiveMagic)
468		if len(archive) < magicLen+4+sha256.Size || string(archive[:magicLen]) != archiveMagic {
469			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unrecognized audit archive", ErrInvalidArchive)
470		}
471		pos := magicLen
472		payloadLen := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(archive[pos : pos+4]))
473		pos += 4
474		checksumEnd := pos + payloadLen
475		if payloadLen < 0 || checksumEnd+sha256.Size != len(archive) {
476			// A short frame is truncation; bytes beyond the one frame (a
477			// concatenated second archive, junk appended to a good file) are a
478			// framing failure too.
479			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: truncated or trailing audit archive bytes", ErrInvalidArchive)
480		}
481		payload := archive[pos:checksumEnd]
482		sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
483		if !bytes.Equal(sum[:], archive[checksumEnd:checksumEnd+sha256.Size]) {
484			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: checksum mismatch", ErrInvalidArchive)
485		}
486	
487		r := &archiveReader{data: payload}
488		embeddedOrg := r.stringField()
489		embeddedEndSeq := r.u32()
490		embeddedFingerprint := r.stringField()
491		// Every record writes two payload markers, a sequence word, two
492		// fingerprint length words and org/kind length words: 22 bytes even
493		// when every string is empty.
494		n := r.boundedCount(22)
495		if r.err != nil {
496			return nil, r.err
497		}
498		records := make([]AuditRecord, 0, n)
499		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
500			var rec AuditRecord
501			rec.Org = r.stringField()
502			rec.Seq = r.u32()
503			rec.Kind = r.stringField()
504			rec.Change = r.change()
505			rec.Decision = r.decisionRecord()
506			rec.PrevFingerprint = r.stringField()
507			rec.Fingerprint = r.stringField()
508			records = append(records, rec)
509		}
510		if r.err != nil {
511			return nil, r.err
512		}
513		if r.pos != len(payload) {
514			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d unconsumed archive bytes", ErrInvalidArchive, len(payload)-r.pos)
515		}
516	
517		// Content checks reuse the exact audit-range validation the live export
518		// and offline review paths use, so an archive can never smuggle in a
519		// shape those entry points would reject.
520		if embeddedOrg != org {
521			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: archive organization %q does not match %q", ErrInvalidRange, embeddedOrg, org)
522		}
523		// The embedded checkpoint is informational; still, contradicting its own
524		// header means the payload was altered, and the authoritative check
525		// below always uses the caller's independently retained checkpoint.
